<!-- pr-reviewer: ebfcedf5edc57192910db4190777f90832985f52 -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (clean review; no blockers).

## What looks good

- Additions only: all 95 new `.cl` goldens (90 motion + 5 app) are new files; zero deletions and zero changes to any existing golden or golden assert. The whole PR is a test/golden addition plus the one existing-test (`headless_bin.rs`) hunk shared byte-for-byte with PR #4123.
- The pins pin the old planner: every motion pin calls the pre-kernel `camcraft_motion::machining2d`/`machining3d` functions (`pocket_started`, `bore_started`, `chamfer`, `circular`, `contour`, `trace_avoid`, `face`, `v_carve`, `slot`, `thread_mill`, `undercut`, `trace`, `trochoidal_slot`, `pocket3d`, `adaptive_trochoidal`, `pocket_started`), and nothing in the tree calls the new (`crates/pathkernel`) code. The app pin drives the app through the #3354 fixture with the same old-planner path (`pocket_op`), recording CL text plus one `; note:` line per note and one `; warning:` line per verifier warning.
- The mod line is appended at the end of `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels.rs`; the two PRs (#4123, #4165) touch different regions of that file and #4123's `headless_bin.rs` hunk is byte-identical to this PR's, so the branches merge in either order.
- The app pin is heavier than budget (5 fig8 generations, >60 s in debug) and is recorded in the heavy lane (`#[ignore = "heavy lane: app heavy: pocket_pass_start ..."]`), with a light twin (`fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline_light`, `#[ignore = "light lane: ..."]`) that records the Waterline Auto case only against the same golden.
- Decision record `docs/decisions/4153-old-planner-baselines.md` exists and lists the dropped alternatives. All 14 motion kind files + `mod.rs` carry the #4153 provenance (mod.rs has the Provenance line; the kind files follow the existing style of the directory suite).

## Trial merge and delta classification

- Worktree `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr4165-review` off `pr-4165-review` (head `ebfcedf5e`, base `side/path-kernel` tip `d1feeb12d`): `git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/side/path-kernel` -> "Already up to date" (the PR is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel`; no conflicts; no local ledger resolution needed).
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 4165 --reviewed 65ec94c5c2a846015eb05a0296924a4e2c121f8a` (and with `--base side/path-kernel`): **NEW CODE: the reviewed head is not in the branch any more (history rewritten) - full review**. There is no counted collaborator review marker at `ebfcedf5e` (or at any earlier head) on the PR, so nothing stands on this head; this review is the full review of the two commits (`78ea9051a` baseline, `ebfcedf5e` round-trip fix).

## Results (local, this worktree)

- Motion: `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels kernel_baseline` -> **15 passed, 0 failed** in 31.4 s (debug). Full suite (`cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels`) -> **34 passed** in 107.6 s (debug); no unrelated test was disturbed.
- CL: `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --test headless_bin` -> **3 passed** (`cl_text_round_trips_every_golden`, `cl_bin_prints_move_stats`, `cl_bin_refuses_bad_input`).
- App (release, as recorded): `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start -- --ignored kernel_baseline` -> **2 passed** in 13.2 s (`fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline` and `fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline_light`).
- Clippy `-D warnings`: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-app --all-targets` -> **clean** (2m34s).
- Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light` -> **6 steps, 0 failed** (wall 3.2 min; `app light: pocket_pass_start` ok in 3 s, `motion light: lib` ok in 119 s). The app light step runs `fig8_pocket_outside_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge_light` and `fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline_light`; both pass.

The author's quick gate on this head (1219 steps, 0 failed) is not re-run here; only the touched suites, the full motion suite and clippy were run locally. No runner was used (dispatcher instruction).

## headless_bin.rs hunk (the one existing test)

- Byte-identical to the same hunk in PR #4123 (whole-file diff between `pr-4165-review` and `pr-4123-review` for `crates/cl/tests/headless_bin.rs` is empty).
- The test is not weaker: `cl_text_round_trips_every_golden` still reads every `.cl` golden in `crates/app/tests/golden`, still parses the CL text (`from_text`, panics on error) and still asserts `to_text(&text) == src` on the CL text. It now also asserts the tail lines (notes/warnings) all start with `; note: ` or `; warning: `, which is an added check. Plain dumps (no notes) still round-trip (empty tail).

## Comments (quick-pass, claim, fix-on) and the goldens-moved section

- Quick-pass comment: verified — the branch is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel` (trial merge clean), the two PRs merge in either order (different regions of `pass_start_levels.rs`; the `headless_bin.rs` hunks are identical), the body starts with `Side branch: side/path-kernel`, has `Goldens moved` and ends with `Refs #4153`, and is ready to review.
- Issue #4153 claim comment: `add golden pins of the old planners for the 15 kinds in new files of existing directory suites, no planner change` — matches the tree: 14 motion kinds (one file each, `mod.rs` with the shared helpers, in the `pass_start_levels` directory suite) + the app-level 2D Pocket (`pocket_pass_start/kernel_baseline.rs`, a submodule of the `pocket_pass_start` binary); no planner code changes.
- Fix-on comment: `pinned by kernel_baseline::* in pass_start_levels (15 tests) and kernel_baseline::fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline (+ _light) in pocket_pass_start ... Head ebfcedf5e` — matches: 15 motion tests, 2 app tests (full + light), head `ebfcedf5e`.
- PR body `Goldens moved`: 90 new motion goldens + 5 new app goldens, additions only — matches the tree exactly (90 and 5, zero deletions, all new files).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The 15 motion kinds: the body counts 14 motion kinds + the app-level 2D Pocket as the "15 kinds"; the motion table itself has 14 rows (the 15th is the app row). That is consistent with the issue's intent (#4153) but worth a one-line clarification in the body if the maintainer wants the table to be 15 rows.
- `docs/decisions/4153-old-planner-baselines.md` says the kind files "carry" the no-vendor-material provenance only through the shared `mod.rs`; per-file provenance lines are not present in the 14 kind files or the app pin file. The existing suite files (`pocket_outside.rs`, `one_ring_set.rs`) follow the same style, so this is a note, not a change request.
- The goldens embed the `; HSMW-CL vN scale=0.001mm` header — the repo's own CL text form (pre-existing on the base); nothing new introduced by this PR.

Closing: a maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
